target_customer: Operations and business teams wanting LLM automations without code
problem: Connecting LLMs to business software reliably requires engineering for prompts, testing, latency and cost.
business_model: SaaS subscription (inferred from demo booking; pricing not seen)

founders.name: Walter Pintor
founders.background_notes: YC page: background in aerospace engineering and mechatronics. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Levity
competitors.what: No-code AI automation for classifying text and images in workflows
competitors.funding_then: seed round covered by TechCrunch January 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Wrapping LLM APIs with integrations and testing tools was straightforward engineering in early 2022, with reliability tooling the main work.

defensibility.rationale: Low switching costs and a thin layer over third-party model APIs; many similar tools launched later.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several no-code AI builders (for example Geppetto, Oct 2022) appeared after the batch; no acquisition of Query Vary found.

market_need_then: GPT-3 had been public since 2020 and no-code tools were popular; demand for non-technical LLM automation was early and unproven in early 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain functional copy: Input Software to LLM to Output Software

brand_strength.rationale: No press, launch thread or community found for the brand; name is descriptive and easily mistyped.

outcome_analysis: Query Vary joined YC in Winter 2022 with a no-code LLM workflow builder, before the ChatGPT wave, and the YC page still lists it as active with six people. No funding, press, shutdown or sale could be found, so the outcome is unknown. Many no-code AI builders and well funded rivals appeared later, so a thin product layer faced heavy competition.
notes: Crunchbase (aggregator) names Dirk Jan van Veen as co-founder and CEO; not on the YC page and no company source opened, so not listed as founder.
